propertySets.name: Pset_CableSegmentTypeCableSegment
propertySets.definition: Electrical cable with a specific purpose to lead electric current within a circuit or any other electric construction. Includes all types of electric cables, mainly several electrical segments wrapped together, e.g. cable, tube, busbar. Note that the number of conductors within a cable is determined by an aggregation mechanism that aggregates the conductors within the cable. A single-core cable is defined in IEV 461-06-02 as being 'a cable having only one core'; a multiconductor cable is defined in IEV 461-06-03 as b eing 'a cable having more than one conductor, some of which may be uninsulated'; a mulicore cable is defined in IEV 461-06-04 as being 'a cable having more than one core'.

properties.name: Standard
properties.definition: The designation of the standard applicable for the definition of the object used.

properties.name: NumberOfCores
properties.definition: The number of cores.

properties.name: OverallDiameter
properties.definition: The overall diameter of a object.

properties.name: RatedTemperature
properties.definition: The range of allowed temperature that a device is certified to handle. The upper bound of this value is the maximum.

properties.name: ScreenDiameter
properties.definition: The diameter of the screen around an object (if present).

properties.name: HasProtectiveEarth
properties.definition:
Indicates whether the object has a protective earth connection (=TRUE) or not (= FALSE).

One core has protective earth marked insulation, Yellow/Green.

properties.name: MaximumOperatingTemperature
properties.definition: The maximum temperature at which a cable or bus is certified to operate.

properties.name: MaximumShortCircuitTemperature
properties.definition: The maximum short circuit temperature at which a cable or bus is certified to operate.

properties.name: SpecialConstruction
properties.definition: Special construction capabilities like self-supporting, flat devidable cable or bus flat non devidable cable or bus supporting elements inside (steal, textile, concentric conductor). Note that materials used should be agreed between exchange participants before use.

properties.name: Weight
properties.definition:
Total weight of object

Weight of cable kg/km.

properties.name: SelfExtinguishing60332_1
properties.definition: Self Extinguishing cable/core according to IEC 60332.1.

properties.name: SelfExtinguishing60332_3
properties.definition: Self Extinguishing cable/core according to IEC 60332.3.

properties.name: HalogenProof
properties.definition: Produces small amount of smoke and irritating Deaerator/Gas.

properties.name: FunctionReliable
properties.definition: Element (such as cable, bus, core) maintain given properties/functions over a given (tested) time and conditions. According to IEC standard.

properties.name: ACResistance
properties.definition: The resistance under AC.

properties.name: CurrentCarryingCapacity
properties.definition: Maximum value of electric current which can be carried continuously by a conductor, a device or an apparatus, under specified conditions without its steady-state temperature exceeding a  specified value. Based on IEC60826-11-13. NOTE: The temperature specified value is maximum Design Ambient Temperature.

properties.name: DCResistance
properties.definition: The resistance under direct current and 20 degrees centigrade.

properties.name: MassPerLength
properties.definition: Mass per length, i.e. mass of a beam with a unit length of extrusion. For example measured in kg/m.

properties.name: MaximumCurrent
properties.definition: The maximum allowed current that a device is certified to handle.

properties.name: MaximumBendingRadius
properties.definition: The maximum bending radius that the cable could withstand.

properties.name: NumberOfWires
properties.definition: The number of wires used in the element.

properties.name: InsulationVoltage
properties.definition:
The insulation voltage.

It indicates the wire-to-ground (metal sheath) insulation voltage or the insulation voltage between the wires.

properties.name: RatedVoltage
properties.definition: The range of allowed voltage that a device is certified to handle. The upper bound of this value is the maximum.

propertySets.name: Pset_CoaxialCable
propertySets.definition: Properties applicable to a coaxial cable, which is a copper cable with a variable number of copper coaxial pair conductors used to transmit data by means of electrical signals, especially at radio frequency. This property set is applicable to a type or occurrence of IfcCableSegment with predefined type CABLESEGMENT.

properties.name: CharacteristicImpedance
properties.definition:
A quantity defined for a mode of propagation at a given frequency in a specific uniform transmission line or uniform waveguide by one of the three following relations:
Z1 = S/ |I|2
Z2 = |U|2 / S
Z3 = U / I
where Z is the complex characteristic impedance, S the complex power and U and I are the values, usually complex, respectively of a voltage and a current conventionally defined for each type of mode by analogy with transmission line equations.

properties.name: CouplingLoss
properties.definition: Indicates the coupling loss of a leaky coaxial cable (radiating cable).

properties.name: MaximumTransmissionAttenuation
properties.definition: Indicates the Maximum transmission attenuation of feeder.

properties.name: NumberOfCoaxialPairs
properties.definition: Indicates the total number of coaxial pairs in the coaxial cable.

properties.name: PropagationSpeedCoefficient
properties.definition: Indicates the propagation speed coefficient.

properties.name: TransmissionLoss
properties.definition: Indicates the transmission loss of the leaky coaxial cable (radiating cable).

properties.name: RadiantFrequency
properties.definition: Indicates the radiant frequency of the leaky coaxial cable (radiating cable).

propertySets.name: Pset_PatchCordCable
propertySets.definition: This property set has properties that are applicable to cable segment and optical cable segment, indicated that the cable is a patch cord cable, which is fitted with connectors at both ends, allowing it to be rapidly and conveniently connected to other cables or to distribution panels.

properties.name: JacketColour
properties.definition: Indicates the colour of the cable or fitting jacket.

propertySets.name: Pset_SymmetricPairCable
propertySets.definition: Properties applicable to a symmetric pair cable, which is is a copper cable with a variable number of copper twisted symmetric pair conductors used to transmit data by means of electrical signals. this property set is applicable to type or occurrence of IfcCableSegment with predefined type CABLESEGMENT

properties.name: NumberOfTwistedPairs
properties.definition: Total number of twisted wire pairs in copper pair cables.

properties.name: NumberOfUntwistedPairs
properties.definition: Total number of untwisted wire pairs in the copper pair cable.
